hypotheses.T1_edge_partitions_recompose_attention: Destination and source partitions each recompose the full changed-minus-base attention write to maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.T2_direct_final_write_is_not_the_main_ro: The final-position-only destination receives at most 0.20 absolute causal Shapley share at every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.T3_early_backbone_writes_locally: At Layers 5 and 6, local-plus-relay destination groups receive at least 0.50 absolute causal Shapley share on every corpus.
hypotheses.T4_relay_front_moves_forward_with_depth: Late-plus-final destination share is larger at Layer 10 than Layer 5 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T5_edited_source_neighborhood_seeds_the_: At Layers 5 and 6, the edited source neighborhood receives at least 0.50 absolute causal Shapley share on every corpus.
hypotheses.T6_later_sources_grow_after_relay: The later-source causal share is larger at Layer 10 than Layer 5 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T7_state_energy_and_behavioral_routing_d: At some layer and corpus, a group's local state projection and causal Shapley projection differ by at least 0.15.
hypotheses.T8_dominant_topology_transfers_ood: The largest destination group and largest source group at every layer are identical across all three corpora.
